Figure 1: Illustration of different experience utilization strategies in self-evolving agents. (a) Initialization-only: experience is injected once at the beginning and remains static throughout the decision process. (b) Always-on: experience is indiscriminately injected at every step, regardless of its necessity. (c) ExpWeave: experience utilization is interwoven with the decision-making process, allowing the agent to decide during reasoning when to retrieve and use experience.
